title: Too many bags when I travel! Also, helicopter?
content: So last night was elaborate. I started out at a work retreat with people at the beach town. I rented a pair of glasses from some kiosk? and they had to be returned by the end of my trip? Lame. The glasses were a purplish grey color and more rectangular. I recall looking at them like “ick do I have to wear these?” Lmao Cut to it is time to leave the beach town with my coworkers and I am looking in every one of my bags for the glasses and the case. I finally found it! Before departing, I noticed my bags were stuffed with random non helpful items, so I just left those bags at the rental. The people around me didn’t seem to notice? Except when I said out loud “why would I drag all of my toys around in bags? I can just leave this stuff here. I am not going to play this game.” I think my coworkers noticed my last comment. Half the time in this world, I am trying to get places and running out of time. I took the power back this time and refused to take those bags. Suddenly, a nice back pack appeared for me to easily put my carry on items for the flight. The most interesting part was that I took a helicopter this time to the airport with a few people. We left the beach town this way and it was way easier than whatever I had been doing before. Also, it was a great overhead view of the entire beach town. Real life connections: #1. I am a toy collector. Many of the items I was stuffing into bags were my own actual toys. I remember feeling uneasy with the way I was smashing them into bags and that’s when I realized I didn’t have to do that at all. #2 I grew up going “down the shore” so my town reflects a lot of this when riding along the “strip”of it. However, the houses for the town are tucked away at the top of a windy hill. This has more trees versus beach and reminds me more of the Hamptons or something. I went once in my whole life and I’ll never forget how cool it was that it was kind of forest like and beachie. #3 I was considering buying this weird product called “frownies “ from an ig ad. I saw someone I knew last night with their entire face covered in them. I remember thinking “I can’t believe I wanted to buy these, they look terrifying in person”.
